notes.title: Munchkin 1.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/bfc7b76ed0135359973b5c3310f6a771ba9846d8.png[/img]

Today’s patch addresses a number of gameplay fixes and improvements, particularly focused on issues identified by the player community.

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweaked the AI to make it more receptive to fair trade offers. Lower difficulty AI players should also be a bit friendlier and more likely to help in combat.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant improvements to connection and stability, reducing the number of times players should experience these kinds of issues during games.
[*] Players should no longer get stuck in a reconnect loop if they are the last player to time out in a multiplayer game. 
[*] Fixed issues when joining from the Dire Wolf Game Room app, and cases where games would not start when a player tried to join from the Game Room app.
[*] Restraining Order should now correctly undo Friendly and Dead Broke
[*] Mobile players should now be able to defeat all Nose-related monsters with Potion of Halitosis.
[*] Fixed an unlocalized prompt which could appear when an opponent is facing Pack Rat.
[*] Playing Illusion on Lust Monster should no longer end the combat immediately instead of allowing you to fight the replacement.
[*] Gummi Golem’s Bad Stuff should now get removed if you’re forced to help in a combat(with Kneepads of Allure, for example).
[*] Removed the ability to decline Looting a dead Munchkin’s Body. The stink will wash out, we promise!
[*] Curse! Income Tax should now get properly redirected by Magic Hat.
[*] Duck of Many Things should now allow you to discard cards from in play in addition to your hand.
[*] Helper Cleric should can now be able to use its ability to fight the Wannabe Vampire.
[*] You should now be able to correctly use Dwarf-only Items while affected by Curse! Amnesia if you have a Fake Beard.
[*] Items affected by Curse! Cursed Thingy should no longer take up hand or other slots if held by a Hireling or attached to a Cheat!
[*] Stopped the AI from cheating at the Dungeon Casino by under-paying.
[*] Made the Humiliation achievement possible to achieve using Curse! Dying Curse. Ironic name for a broken achievement, no?
[*] Piñata no longer has an incorrect prompt header for its Bad Stuff.
[*] Clarified the language around sending an Ask for Help offer to other players. 
[*] If you add a card to the Charity window and then remove it, it should now have a highlight in your hand to represent it still being legal to give.
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] In rare cases, the AI may ask a level 9 Elf for help in combat, unintentionally granting them an easy win.
[*] A jump-in window to use Take Me! Take Me! is missing before a Bard uses Enthrall.
[*] Friendly can currently be played on a “Sleeping” monster, which should not be allowed.
[/list]
As always, if you run into trouble or need any help, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or join the player community on Discord. Thanks for playing Munchkin!

notes.title: Munchkin Patch 1.5.3—Munchkin-ing Around Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/391c8f9ff160f5d7b1bae7653d5a5b697659d6e4.png[/img]

We’ve got a small but mighty patch for you! This update focuses on addressing various community-reported issues and swatting away pesky bugs for smoother gameplay and improved user experience. Read on!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [i]Typographical Error[/i] should now have an effect when played on a Mate. 
[*] Fixed a graphical lock that occurred when a player timed out on the Inventory screen during [i]Casting Couch[/i].
[*] Chat should now work throughout the game even when players leave the lobby. 
[*] [i]Temporary Amnesia[/i] curse should now remain in hand when combat is lost. 
[*] Players can no longer use [i]Wishing Ring[/i] incorrectly on [i]Crawling Hand[/i]. 
[*] Playing [i]Go Up a Level[/i] cards should now only produce one action log entry.
[*] Action log should now show items involved in failed theft attempts. 
[*] AI Behavior Update: If an AI has been affected by the [i]Chicken on Your Head[/i] headgear item, and a player uses a Curse to remove it, the AI's opinion of the player will not decrease.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support as we improve your [i]Munchkin Digital [/i]experience! Keep the feedback coming. Happy Munchkin-ing!

notes.title: Munchkin Patch 1.5.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/e47142547f6d2244ce0e9bbc608a6ad7fe3fa7cc.png[/img]

Munchkins, take heed! This patch adds virtual keyboard support to Steam, makes some AI improvements, fixes a localization mistake, and fixes some bugs.

[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Players on Steam should now have a virtual keyboard
[*] Bigfoot Bad Stuff should remove Chicken on Your Head
[*] Players who die from Clerical Error should now animate as a ghost instead of their avatar
[*] AI should make better choices with Magnificent Hat and curse prevention
[*] AI should now discard more carefully with Dungeon Casino
[*] AI should no longer target Gnome illusion with a monster enhancer
[*] Resuming a saved game now shows the selected timer instead of always showing Normal
[*] Dungeon Casino German localization now reads draw 3 instead of draw 33
[*] A bard can no longer use Enthrall when cursed with B.O. Just too much stink.
[*] Clerics should be prompted to use Resurrection on iOS and Android
[*] A player can longer select an item with Garage Sale when there are no valid items in the discard pile
[*] Minimizing inventory prompt after using Casting Couch should no longer cause other art and prompts to fail
[/list]

We greatly appreciate your enthusiasm and support for [i]Munchkin[/i] as we continue bringing you the most authentic, door-kicking, treasure-snatching digital adaptation we can. Your feedback matters to us! If you encounter anything in game that’s off, please reach out using the in-game feedback option or via email to support@direwolfdigital.com.


As always, thanks for playing Munchkin, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Munchkin Digital Clerical Errors—Even More Munchkin!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/45273c3bb2eca8cd726f587245b1523a297d783f.jpg[/img]


Another 112 cards for your collection of dastardly monsters and zany loot is coming your way [b]Monday, July 15th![/b] And we hope you are prepared to make some difficult choices. You can: become a Gnome Bard and subject your foes to discordant tones; don your Chainmail Bikini or kick on some Freudian Slippers, then do battle with the fearsome Tequila Mockingbird. So much mischief, so little time!

[h1]New Challenges![/h1]
[b]Test your Munchkinly mettle with seven new challenges to overcome![/b]
[list]
[*] Bardic Shuffle – can you overcome the new set’s obstacles with a little extra luck?
[*] Munchkin Roulette – spin the wheel and win big at The Dungeon Casino!
[*] Mimic Infestation – looting the room has never been deadlier! You do like mimics, right?
[*] The Illusion of Choice – pick a card, any card…
[*] Perfectly Balanced Monster Design – all encounters balanced to your strength, for the discerning strategy gamer.
[*] Clergy Conundrum – have faith… whether you want to or not!
[*] Loot Goblin – get rich or die trying! Is it really a win if you don’t walk out with a dragon’s hoard?
[/list]
[h2]More Achievements![/h2]
[list]
[*] 15 new achievements for all the completionist Munchkins out there. Will you prove yourself as a Noble Knight, or will you suffer ultimate Humiliation?
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and Improvements [/h2]
This patch includes numerous fixes and improvements to make sure you can go about your Munchkinly activities in peace:
[list]
[*] Fake Beard’s scruff is vastly improved and now properly “hides” your other Race(s) from monsters.
[*] Bigfoot found his appetite, so his  Bad Stuff will now correctly remove Chicken on Your Head.
[*] Wishing Ring can now save you from Curse! New Edition Rules.
[*] Help Me Out Here can no longer result in you using extra Items. Sorry, you’ll need a valid Cheat! for that!
[*] Help Me Out Here can also no longer steal Items you can’t equip. That’s the kind of help we all could do without.
[*] Out To Lunch will now reduce the treasure reward of the combat to 2, regardless of how many monsters were in the combat, as intended.
[*] The discard prompt for Deck of Too Many Things should no longer close unpredictably.
[*] Wand of Dowsing’s prompt has been adjusted to no longer block buttons on widescreen phones. It’s supposed to help you find things, not hide them!
[*] Raincoat, Knight Light, and other “can be worn over another Item” effects now properly discard the extra equipment in certain cases where they previously did not.
[*] While you have a discard prompt pending but minimized, you can no longer drag cards from your hand to prevent unintentional discards.
[/list]
[i]Now… go make mischief![/i]

notes.title: Munchkin 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/e47142547f6d2244ce0e9bbc608a6ad7fe3fa7cc.png[/img]

A very mischievous hello to you all!

This patch brings [i]Munchkin [/i]players an improved experience to numerous parts of the game: we’ve improved character creation during match setup so cards act more intuitively, clarified Discard UX, and improved the presentation of the Action Log and various odds and ends on different screens and menus.

Additionally, we made systemic improvements that address current bugs and avoid future ones, and improved how timers and VFX are handled during multiplayer gameplay.

Finally, we’ve continued to squash rare softlocks and fixed a number of corner-case gameplay bugs. All in all, we are very excited to bring these improvements to players and eagerly await your feedback and requests.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Action Log notifications
[*] Improved game setup and character creation
[*] The game flow will remain the same, as this is mostly a backend fix. However, it will flow more naturally
[*] Improved Discard UX
[*] Improved App Stability across devices
[*] Improved multiplayer UX around timers, jump-ins, VFX, and animations.
[*] In general, these changes will mean less downtime waiting for animations. More time for Mischief!
[*] Improved AI valuations in various cases
[*] Various quality of life improvements to the playmat and player HUD
[*] Some highlights:
[*] Action log items now have notifications associated with them, so you can see what just happened without having to search through the full log
[*] Clarified what’s happening during Ask For Help selections for non-active players.
[*] Improved contextual updates to the HUD during combat –Never miss when the monster’s rewards have been changed again!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Under-the-hood improvements for fixing and avoiding gameplay bugs
[*] Numerous fixes for specific gameplay cases around characters, classes, items, inventories, and cards
[/list]

[h2]Community Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] In addition to our internal testing, we’ve fixed a number of issues reported by you, our amazing community! We continue to value and appreciate your feedback. (Keep it coming! support@direwolfdigital.com)
[/list]

Community-reported improvements made and issues fixed in this patch:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to change your selections before confirming cards to discard. Accidentally dropped in that Blessed Mallet? You can drag it back out now
[*] Resolved a gameplay issue where Doppelganger was put into the discard pile before combat ended, which could cause improper interactions with Dowsing Rod
[*] Items with passive abilities other than bonus strength now properly apply their abilities to their new owners when stolen or traded
[*] Players will now always properly get their treasure rewards when avoiding combat with monsters like the Amazon
[*] Help Me Out Here can no longer be used to steal Kneepads of Allure if you can’t actually use the Kneepads to charm someone.
[*] Improved the clarity of the prompting for Curse! Lose Your Class when the target is a Super Munchkin
[*] Action log entries related to Curses now identify the target of the Curse.
[/list]


[i]Thank you for playing Munchkin![/i]

notes.title: Munchkin Patch 1.3.3— Time Out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/a47965eb2d66c2127596731c252a16536931c465.jpg[/img]

Howdy!

Today’s patch is focused on resolving issues with jump-in timers in multiplayer games with AI players, as well as fixing softlock issues. This patch also resolves a handful of gameplay bugs, which will improve player’s quality of life.

As always, if you encounter anything in game that seems like it’s not supposed to be that way, please drop us a line using the in-game feedback option, or via email to Support@DireWolfDigital.com. You can also poke us on Discord.

Thanks for playing[i] Munchkin[/i]!

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*] Updated Theft tooltip and Thief card text to more accurately reflect which situations it may be used in.[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] AI’s Looking For Trouble animation in multiplayer can no longer reduce a player’s jump-in timer.
[*] Animation buffer will now properly keep any animations from an AI’s previous jump-in action from reducing the timer on any subsequent jump-ins.
[*] Jump-in timers will no longer be reduced after an AI takes over for a human player.
[*] The AI now properly equips multiple race and class cards during the character creation phase if it starts with Super Munchkin or Half-Breed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI could sometimes start the game with more than 2 Hands worth of Items equipped. No Cheating in Munchkin!
[*] Resolved a corner case where Orcs could erroneously get a bonus level due to bonus strength that shouldn’t count in the fight (against Ghoulfiends, for example).
[*] Raincoat now properly blocks all Potions.
[*] AI names will now be properly localized in all situations.
[*] Curse prompt text will no longer exceed the bounds of the textbox. This was an issue in German only.
[*] Fixed a number of uncommon softlocks.[/list]


[i]Thank you![/i]

notes.title: Hotfix Time! A Bit of Both

Howdy!

[list]
[*]Various fixes for gameplay flow and text issues.

[*]Players will now be alerted of illegal moves when playing incorrect hand

[*]Dead Broke should no longer remove treasures from a monster permanently

notes.title: Unnatural Things Come to Munchkin! Patch Notes 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/c4decd2c862f5fc017abe091a6e3270edc2a754f.jpg[/img]
Unnatural things are coming to Munchkin! Today’s patch introduces Munchkin’s first DLC pack - the Unnatural Axe expansion. It also contains numerous improvements to improve the clarity of game sequences and UI screens, and squashes some pesky bugs.

As always, if you encounter anything in game that seems like it’s not supposed to be that way, please drop us a line using the in-game feedback option, or via email to Support@DireWolfDigital.com.


[i]Thanks for playing Munchkin!
[/i]
[h1]Unnatural Axe Expansion
[/h1][list]
[*] Unnatural Axe expansion is now available to purchase!
[*] 111 new cards to sling!
[*] 14 new achievements to strive for!
[*] 6 dastardly challenges to conquer![/list][h1]Improvements[/h1]
[h3]Action Log
[/h3][list]
[*] New turn line item now displays in larger font.
[*] Action log no longer auto-scrolls while open. If new messages appear while open, an indicator will appear.[/list][h3]Combat[/h3][list]
[*] Player avatars will now remain on screen after combat until rewards have been received.
[*] One-shot items and monster enhancers played during combat now linger on screen longer.[/list][h3]Action Clarity[/h3][list]
[*] Most game actions now display a stinger animation which displays the card used for the  action, the action’s name, and the portrait of the player who used the action. This includes any action involving moving or playing a card or using a class ability.
[*] Cards that are actually being played from hand or used from the carried pile now display on screen longer.
[*] AI now briefly pause at the start of combat before taking actions to give players time to read the monster card.
[*] Look for Trouble and Loot the Room have new animations that play when selected.
[*] Added new animation when a monster is discarded from combat.[/list]
[h3]Mobile[/h3][list]
[*] Increased the displayed size of played cards on mobile.
[*] Increased size of action buttons for class/race abilities and carried items on mobile.[/list]
[h3]Pacing[/h3][list]
[*] Cards which are discarded without being used will now move off-screen quicker.[/list]
[h3]AI[/h3][list]
[*] AI’s ask for help logic improved so it should no longer accept help from players who won’t increase its strength enough to win the fight. [i]They’re learning![/i][/list]
[h3]HUD[/h3][list]
[*] The hand fan in the opponent panels in the HUD now displays different card backs depending on how many Door vs Treasure cards they are holding.
[*] Added the ability to swap between players’ inventory screens from within the inventory itself. Press the shiny new arrow buttons to swap whose items you’re looking at!
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Killing Squidzilla no longer erroneously award the Dragon Slayer achievement. Real dragon slayers only!
[*] The AI to now equips race and class cards if it had none equipped already to avoid donating them to charity.
[*] Two Thieves can now backstab the same player, as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where Curse! Lose 2 Cards, when targeting a player with only 1 card in hand, would give that card to the wrong player.
[*] Prior to patch, Curse! Chicken On Your Head would be removed if your helmet was discarded by any means. Now it is only removed if your helmet is taken by a curse or bad stuff, as intended.
[*] Help Me Out Here can no longer be used to steal non-armor items while the user is cursed with Malign Mirror.
[*] The game now immediately ends if Divine Intervention was used to gain the winning level during combat.
[*] Players can now choose to lose levels to Platycore’s bad stuff while they are level 2.
[*] If a player times out while using Wand of Dowsing, the AI will now properly pick a card for them.
[*] Mate monsters now they pay out the same treasure as the original monster, as intended. You know, the whole point of a monster.
[*] Invisibility Potion now works properly when used to escape the second monster in a combat.
[*] Players can no longer use Doppelganger (and other one-shot items) twice in one combat by re-drawing them with Wand of Dowsing, as intended.
[*] Flask of Glue is now playable after an opponent used Invisibility Potion.
[*] Help Me Out Here can now steal Kneepads of Allure.
[*] Fixed an issue where stealing a card attached to Cheat! would also steal Cheat!. Cheat! is now correctly discarded.
[*] The AI no longer accept trades for big items when they’re already carrying a big item.
[*] The player can no longer trick the AI into giving them a free big item.
[*] Removed a softlock that could occur when a player needed to give away a big item but all players were at their big item max.
[*] Addressed a mobile-specific softlock where the go up a level prompt could not be un-minimized.
[*] Online timers no longer end before they should in games where all other players have dropped and been replaced with AI.
[*] The game will no longer prompt players to change their class to Cleric when Divine Intervention is played outside of setup, as intended.
[*] Halflings can no longer use their reroll ability infinite times if they had automatically escaped another monster in the combat.
[*] Halflings can now use their reroll ability against multiple monsters.
[*] Instant Wall now automatically escapes all monsters, instead of just one monster.
[*] The run away bonus from Tuba of Charm and Boots of Running Really Fast no longer remains on the player if those items were looted from their corpse.
[*] The chat box was displaying smaller than intended. Its size has been increased to address this.
[*] Horny Helmet’s bonus no longer displays improperly for Elf players. Note that this was only a visual issue, the player’s strength was being correctly updated on the backend.
[*] The run away bonus from Tuba of Charm and Boots of Running Really Fast no longer remains on the player if those items were looted from their corpse
[/list]

Additionally, we’re investigating the following issues:
[list]
[*] Rare softlock where the kick open the door prompt does not appear
[*] Rare softlock where the AI can get stuck after combat in timer-enabled games
[/list]

notes.title: Munchkin Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
You've been busy this week! Today's patch addresses a handful of UI elements and softlock issues identified by the community since release:

notes.title: Welcome to Munchkin!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/a47965eb2d66c2127596731c252a16536931c465.jpg[/img]

Munchkin Digital is now available! Today, we’re leaving Early Access and opening up the doors for cross-platform play, so get in there and meet some new adventurers! Your feedback and support over the past couple of months have been invaluable to getting Munchkin to this milestone, and we’re looking forward to continuing to help the community flourish and the game grow.

With this release, we’re introducing:

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full cross-platform play on Steam, iTunes, and Google Play. Defeat your enemies wherever you may find them!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/b956f7f2a39f0a17d50bebcc26b2f92f1d87fd4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added ability to choose avatar when playing Challenges
[*] Can now cycle through opponents’ inventories without exiting the inventory window for easier trading
[*] New animation for Monsters that are discarded but not defeated
[*] Improved presentation of which side is winning in combat
[*] Buff/Debuff Icons added to communicate modifications to monster strength which can be tapped to reveal the source of the effect
[*] The highlight color for interactable items in inventory is now distinct from the swap items highlight
[*] AI now more likely to save one shots to use on themselves
[*] Updates to prompt triggers to improve pacing
[*] Update to card titles in the inventory to match the casing used for full card titles and for extended localizations support
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/b956f7f2a39f0a17d50bebcc26b2f92f1d87fd4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Continued focus reducing the number of softlock, crash, and gameplay related bugs
[*] Addressed a desync issue occurring during multiplayer game
[*] Bad stuff now occurs when running away from Monster’s Mate
[*] Dead players may no longer receive items via trade
[*] Fixed an issue where a mate would not visually update the treasure on offer in combat
[*] And many more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/b956f7f2a39f0a17d50bebcc26b2f92f1d87fd4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements From Early Access[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added French, Spanish, German and Turkish localization
[*] Lengthened timers and created a no-timer option for game creation
[*] Added more details for when your help offer is declined/rejected
[*] Fixed a significant number of soft-locks, crashes, and gameplay related bugs
[*] Discarding card animation is faster and more clear
[*] VFX added to make it more apparent where equipped cards/classes/races are going
[*] AI now delays slightly in taking actions so there’s time to see what’s happening on their turn
[*] Configuring your inventory now has more clear indicators of what can be moved or selected
[*] Added warnings to some of the most common gameplay mistakes to make sure players are making the moves they intend
[*] Action log no longer scrolls automatically when new actions are taken for easier readability during enemy turns
[*] Tutorial 1 and 2 now clarify how configuring items works in your inventory
[*] Ongoing UX and legibility improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42903726/b956f7f2a39f0a17d50bebcc26b2f92f1d87fd4e.jpg[/img]

We’re excited for where this next adventure goes, and grateful for your help in getting this far!

As always, if you’re enjoying your time in Munchkin, please take a moment to leave a review and let your fellow adventurers know what they’re missing…it’s the best way to help spread the word and welcome new players.

And if you run into trouble along the way, please drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so that we can investigate and help.

Thanks for playing Munchkin! Now go kick open that door!

notes.notes:
Today’s Munchkin Patch 1.1.0 expands language support to our German and Turkish friends, and includes a variety of UX improvements to the tutorial and gameplay! Willkommen and Hoşgeldiniz!

[b]New features[/b]

notes.title: Munchkin Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Munchkin Patch 1.0.1 focuses on feedback that we’ve received from Steam Early Access players to improve the gameplay experience and clarity of certain interactions. One highly requested item to note: turn and action timers have been increased in this patch, and we’re looking into more configurable options for timers as we continue to fine-tune the overall pacing of the game.

Thank you to everyone who has contributed feedback – we’ll be continuing to work on improvements along the way to cross-platform launch!

Here’s what’s in today’s patch:

[b]Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] We’ve addressed several instances of softlock, and we’re continuing to investigate other softlocks reported by the community
[*] Addressed instance where players could find themselves unable to play cards from hand
[*] Players should now receive achievements for completing a tutorial or a challenge (those already eligible will have to complete a tutorial or challenge again)
[*] Pressing Shift + Enter no longer breaks the feedback form.
[/list]

[b]Rules Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Players should now only be able to Charity down to the hand limit
[*] AI players should no longer use Friendship Potion to run away when unnecessary
[*] In several instances where Hireling items weren’t correctly discarded by curse or bad stuff, eligible items should now discard correctly
[*] Sandals of Protection should now work when equipped by Hireling
[*] Hireling will now steal a treasure when running away with Tuba of Charm
[*] Addressed Ask for Help issue specific to Double Trouble challenge
[*] Addressed instance where AI should become more hostile towards player
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved clarity when defeating a monster will grant multiple levels
[*] The name and image of cards that are causing a prompt are now displayed
[*] Flicker on monster texts at start of combat no longer appears
[*] It should be more clear when your opponents are still creating their characters
[*] Timer will now display when players near the end of their time
[*] When offering a trade, player can now see when an opponent is considering the offer
[*] Theft ability now shows the correct owner of each available item
[*] Flight Spell now displays needed number of cards for a successful run away
[*] Cheat! card now displays stinger when played by an opponent
[*] Animation fix for Track Meet challenge
[*] Add Friend prompt now mentions adding via friend code
[/list]

[b]Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] When prompted to draft treasures, players can now select cards as well as checkboxes
[*] Doubled the length of action timers and increased Jump-In timers by 5 seconds
[/list]

As always, if you’re enjoying playing Munchkin, please consider taking a moment to rate and review the game on Steam – it’s a great way to spread the word and help find new players for you to swindle.

If you run into trouble (whether or not you went looking for it), drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com. Thanks for your support, and thanks for playing Munchkin!

notes.title: Chaotic card game Munchkin mooches onto Steam
notes.notes:
Within the joyful depths of tabletop board gaming lies a genre known as 'take-that' style card games. They revolve around people pulling out cards that suddenly give them extra power or abilities, with counterplays almost entirely dependent on whether you happen to draw the right card in response. Munchkin is the king of these, at least in terms of popularity, having sent millions of players all over the world into dungeons where they competitively slay goofy horrors.

I cannot stand it, but it is now on Steam in early access, and statistically speaking a lot of people will be very happy about that.

notes.title: Munchkin Early Access Known Issues
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] In rare cases, the game will freeze when the AI dies after Asking for Help.
[*] Simultaneous right+left clicks will freeze the game when moving a card to the drop zone.
[*] Losing connection sends the user to the landing screen.
[*] Timers are hidden when the inventory screen and other pop-up windows are open. 
[*] Rarely, Magic Lamp does not end combat properly.
[*] Cards that share a slot do not go to the correct location during setup.
[/list]
  

[h1]Rules Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chicken on your Head does not reduce secondary rolls by 1.
[*] Some items that can technically only be equipped are allowed to be carried such as Spiky Knees.
[*] Unable to use Wand of Dowsing in the step right before Charity. 
[*] Tongue Demon triggers a discard prompt when the player has no items.
[*] Players cursed by Malign Mirror are able to play one-shot items that give strength bonuses on themselves.
[*] Items equipped with the Hireling are immune to some curses they shouldn't be. 
[/list]

[h1]Polish Needs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Action log scrolling moves too fast when looking through multiple turns of info.
[*] Each player is prompted individually for Income Tax in Multiplayer games.
[*] One-Shot Items display "Discarded" when used.
[*] Hireling is shown being discarded before Kill the Hireling is displayed.
[*] Go Up a Level prompt cannot be minimized. 
[*] Priority does not pass back to the player whose turn it is after opponents are done jumping-in during combat. 
[*] Ability to change the gender of avatars isn’t well messaged 
[*] Many triggered abilities have incomplete visual messaging
[*] Resurrection prompt isn’t showing the card you will draw from discard pile
[*] Online timer lengths still need polish to allow more time for Asking for Help
[/list]

notes.title: Famous tabletop game Munchkin is going digital
notes.notes: Love it or hate it, Munchkin has been a fixture of the tabletop gaming scene for 20 years, a take-that backstabbing card game where players seek to be the first, richest, most horrible little person to get level 10. It's finally coming to digital, as Dire Wolf has announced an adaptation in partnership with Munchkin publisher Steve Jackson Games... Read more.
